name: claudegotchi
description: Shows how your Claude Code sessions are doing on a little e-ink critter. Sends metadata only, never prompts or code.

url.title: Gotchi address
url.description: Leave empty for automatic: USB cable first, then your gotchi's name over Wi-Fi. Or e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8765, or none for relay only.

gotchi.title: Gotchi name
gotchi.description: The name your gotchi shows on screen, e.g. claudegotchi-3f2a. Leave empty if you plug it in by USB once: the client then learns it.

token.title: Token
token.description: The gotchi's [server] token. Pairing sets one up for you.

relay.title: Relay URL
relay.description: ntfy topic URL, only for Claude Code in the cloud. See the docs on claudegotchi.lottes.dev.
